verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Feature Flags API for assigning users to variants for experiments, rollout, and releases (mixpanel-docs-36), and a separate hosted MCP server for natural-language querying and dashboard creation (mixpanel-docs-10/11/19). However, there is no evidence that flag creation or toggling is exposed via the MCP server, nor documentation confirming full CRUD (create/toggle) operations through the API beyond targeting/assignment. missing for 10: MCP tool list including feature-flag creation/toggle, explicit API endpoints for creating and toggling flags, and any hands-on confirmation of agent-driven flag management.
